xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-3396: bug(membership): zombie_pr bucket resurrects closed-out issues as inPipeline and offers no disposition path for recordless pre-record-era rows

plan.title: bug(membership): zombie_pr bucket resurrects closed-out issues as inPipeline and offers no disposition path for recordless pre-record-era rows
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: The membership resolver classifies a tracker-closed issue with a still-open convention PR as zombie_pr/inPipeline without consulting the durable close-out record, so already-closed-out issues (e.g. MIN-882) resurrect into the operator-visible exception queue. Separately, pre-record-era closed issues with stale PRs (MIN-172/572/576/596/620/622/632) can never leave the bucket: pan close fails the DoD gate with 'no review status or journal record found' and no disposition door exists.
narratives.Proposal: Add a durable L7-record lens (hasTerminalCloseOut = record.pipeline.closedOut === true, read via the record door) to IssueLensSignals; a tracker-closed issue with an open PR AND a terminal close-out record classifies clean_terminal with the leftover PR named as residue in the reason. Add `pan close --residue <reason>` (operator-conversation-only, tracker-closed pre-verified via isTrackerIssueClosed) which closes stale convention PRs/MRs with an honest no-merge-claim comment, writes an all-skip residue DoD gate audit carrying the verified evidence, and marks the per-issue record terminal WITHOUT asserting mergeStatus: 'merged'. Full design decisions D1-D10 and before/after snippets are in the PRD at .pan/drafts/PAN-3396.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Granting the flywheel or any non-conv-* caller the --residue door (separate policy decision)
- Changing population-2 behavior (genuine close-out lag keeps classifying zombie_pr and drains through standard close-out)
- Closing or reconciling the specific 11 MIN rows observed in RUN-79 (operator action with the shipped door, not code)
- Retroactively closing MIN-882's leftover PR from the resolver (the resolver classifies; it never mutates forge state)
- GitHub-app PR-close path in the residue module (default deps use the gh/glab CLI precedent)
- Any frontend/dashboard change (bucket vocabulary and DTO unchanged)

autoDecisions.summary: Disposition door is `pan close --residue <reason>`, operator-conversation-only (conv-*) like --abandon
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names this exact flag shape as its example and no alternative is documented; bypassing the DoD gate's evidence is a judgment call, so it takes the same trust tier as --abandon rather than being granted to the flywheel in this issue.

autoDecisions.summary: --residue closes stale convention PRs/MRs itself with an honest comment instead of refusing while they exist
autoDecisions.rationale: A disposition door that refuses on the exact condition it exists to clear would be useless for the recordless population; a PR close is reversible (reopen) and the comment explicitly does not claim a merge, avoiding the anti-lie guards in close-issue.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: Tracker-closed pre-verification uses isTrackerIssueClosed() rather than --abandon's GitHub-only canonical read
autoDecisions.rationale: The affected population (MIN-*) is Linear-tracked with GitLab MRs; isTrackerIssueClosed is the existing tracker-agnostic door the DoD gate already uses.

autoDecisions.summary: No new PipelineBucket — clean_terminal plus an audit reason carries the reclassified state
autoDecisions.rationale: A sixth bucket would churn @overdeck/contracts, frontend grouping, and consumer filters for zero behavioral gain; the issue's fix direction explicitly says classify clean_terminal (audit-only).

autoDecisions.summary: The terminal-close-out lens reads only the durable record (pipeline.closedOut), not live review status
autoDecisions.rationale: Membership is durable-only by invariant (L5 never decides membership); by ceremony step 8 the tracker issue is already closed, so a mid-ceremony-aborted runtime plane never justifies resurrecting the issue into the pipeline.

metadata.sizeJustification: 18 files / 8 subsystems is one inseparable bug fix, not bundled scope: the resolver lens (src/lib) and the gather that feeds it are two halves of the zombie_pr reclassification and must land together; the --residue disposition door (src/cli + src/lib/lifecycle) is the issue's second named fix direction and shares the DoD-gate/record-door types the first half touches; tests/ and scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt are mandatory companions of those code changes (quality gates), and docs/ + sync-sources/ are the mandated documentation work item that must ship in the same commits (SKILLS-CONVENTION, dod-doc-drift). No item is independently shippable as a sibling issue without leaving the tree contradictory.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Add required dep `hasTerminalCloseOutRecord(project, issueId): Promise<boolean>` to PipelineMembershipGatherDeps (required so existing fixtures fail typecheck until they declare lens behavior). Default impl reads readIssueRecord(project, issueId)?.pipeline.closedOut === true, catching errors to false (fail toward zombie_pr visibility). In gatherProjectLensSignals, after candidate states are final (after the GitHub unknown-state block, before the merged-head fan-out), probe only candidates that are tracker-closed AND have an open PR, collecting a closedOutRecordIssues set; add `hasTerminalCloseOut: closedOutRecordIssues.has(id)` to the assembled signals. Tests: extend the deps() fixture with the new dep; closed+open-PR candidate with dep true → signal true and end-to-end clean_terminal via resolvePipelineMembership; dep false → zombie_pr; assert the dep is never called for open issues or closed issues without open PRs.
